excerpt: Solving Seasonal Labour Shortages: Best Practices for Recruiting Agricultural Workers Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. Ghosting—when a candidate suddenly stops responding during the hiring process—has become a top challenge for recruiters and employers worldwide. In today’s competitive job market, understanding why candidate ghosting happens and how to prevent it is crucial for successful talent acquisition, employer branding, and workforce stability. This comprehensive guide explores the root causes of ghosting in recruitment, the impact on businesses, and actionable strategies recruiters can use to reduce ghosting and keep candidates engaged.
author: Anuj Sengar
